mentions.name: Syntverk
mentions.description: Syntverk is an agentic code IDE built as a native cross-platform app in Rust with Tauri. It offers multi-tab worktree-isolated agents, sandboxed tools, git integration, a built-in code editor with inline generation, and searchable document support so users or agents can query uploaded docs and datasheets. It includes built-in local image generation (stable diffusion and flux schnell) with asset handling for game developers, and a remote feature to share the GUI or deploy it on a server for access on the go. Text-to-3d is being added.
